```{r}
#| label: load-packages

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(gtExtras)

```

```{r}
#| label: allen-oh-2020

# Importing data
allen_oh_2020_raw <- read_excel(
  "data/Ohio 2020/Data/Allen County CVR Data/Allen_OH_2020.xlsx"
  ) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  suppressWarnings()

# Restructuring the data
allen_oh_2020 <- allen_oh_2020_raw |> 
  
  # Selecting races of interest (major partisan races and Supreme Court)
  select(cast_vote_record, for_president_and_vice_president, 
         for_representative_to_congress_4th_district, 
         for_state_senator_12th_district, 
         for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_1,
         for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_2
         ) |> 
  # Renaming columns/races for conciseness
  rename(
    pres = for_president_and_vice_president,
    us_rep_4d = for_representative_to_congress_4th_district,
    state_sen_12d = for_state_senator_12th_district,
    sc_justice_20_1 = for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_1,
    sc_justice_20_2 = for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_2
  ) |> 
  
  # Filtering out any ballots that had an error or chose not to vote in any races of interest
  filter(
    if_all(everything(), ~ is.na(.) | !grepl("undervote|overvote", 
                                                  as.character(.),
                                                  ignore.case = TRUE)),
         !is.na(pres),
         str_detect(pres, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(us_rep_4d, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(state_sen_12d, "Rep|Dem")
    ) |> 
  
  # Changing ballot choices from candidates' names to their respective parties
  mutate(
    pres = if_else(
      str_detect(pres, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    us_rep_4d = if_else(
      str_detect(us_rep_4d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_sen_12d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_sen_12d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_20_1 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_20_1, "Sharon"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_20_2 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_20_2, "Judi"), "GOP", "DEM"),
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter voted exclusively for one party in the races of interest, besides the Supreme Court races
  mutate(
    party_line_voter = case_when(
      pres == "GOP" & us_rep_4d == "GOP" & state_sen_12d == "GOP" ~ "GOP",
      pres == "DEM" & us_rep_4d == "DEM" & state_sen_12d == "DEM" ~ "DEM",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter's Supreme Court race choices aligned with their choices for the other races of interest
  mutate(
    sc_races_matching = case_when(
      party_line_voter == "GOP" & sc_justice_20_1 == "GOP" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "GOP" ~ TRUE,
      party_line_voter == "DEM" & sc_justice_20_1 == "DEM" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "DEM" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# Importing data

         for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_1_25, 
         for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_2_25,

  # Renaming columns/races for conciseness

    pres = for_president_and_vice_president,
    us_rep_4d = for_representative_to_congress_4th_district,
    us_sen = for_u_s_senator,
    sc_justice_24_1 = for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_1_25,

  filter(
    if_all(everything(), ~ is.na(.) | !grepl("undervote|overvote", 
                                                  as.character(.),
                                                  ignore.case = TRUE)),
         !is.na(pres),
         str_detect(pres, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(us_sen, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(us_rep_4d, "Rep|Dem")
    ) |> 
  
  # Changing ballot choices from candidates' names to their respective parties
  mutate(
    pres = if_else(
      str_detect(pres, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    us_sen = if_else(
      str_detect(us_sen, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),

      str_detect(sc_justice_24_2, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_24_3 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_24_3, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM")
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter voted exclusively for one party in the races of interest, besides the Supreme Court races
  mutate(
    party_line_voter = case_when(
      pres == "GOP" & us_rep_4d == "GOP" & us_sen == "GOP" ~ "GOP",
      pres == "DEM" & us_rep_4d == "DEM" & us_sen == "DEM" ~ "DEM",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter's Supreme Court race choices aligned with their choices for the other races of interest
  mutate(
    sc_races_matching = case_when(
      party_line_voter == "GOP" & sc_justice_24_1 == "GOP" &
```

```{r}
#| label: ashtabula-oh-2020

# Importing data
ashtabula_oh_2020_raw <- read_excel(
  "data/Ohio 2020/Data/Ashtabula County CVR Data/Ashtabula_OH_2020.xlsx"
  ) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  suppressWarnings()

# Restructuring the data
ashtabula_oh_2020 <- ashtabula_oh_2020_raw |> 
  
  # Selecting races of interest (major partisan races and Supreme Court)
  select(cast_vote_record, president_and_vice_president, representative_to_congress_14th_district, 
         state_senator_32nd_district, state_representative_64th_district,          
         state_representative_99th_district, justice_of_the_supreme_court_18,
         justice_of_the_supreme_court_19) |> 
  # Renaming columns/races for conciseness
  rename(
    pres = president_and_vice_president,
    us_rep_14d = representative_to_congress_14th_district,
    state_sen_32d = state_senator_32nd_district,
    state_rep_64d = state_representative_64th_district,
    state_rep_99d = state_representative_99th_district,
    sc_justice_20_1 = justice_of_the_supreme_court_18,
    sc_justice_20_2 = justice_of_the_supreme_court_19
  ) |> 
  
  # Filtering out any ballots that had an error or chose not to vote in any races of interest
  filter(
    if_all(everything(), ~ is.na(.) | !grepl("undervote|overvote", 
                                                  as.character(.),
                                                  ignore.case = TRUE)),
         !is.na(pres),
         str_detect(pres, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(us_rep_14d, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(state_sen_32d, "Rep|Dem"),
         !(is.na(state_rep_64d) & is.na(state_rep_99d))
    ) |> 
  
  # Changing ballot choices from candidates' names to their respective parties
  mutate(
    pres = if_else(
      str_detect(pres, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    us_rep_14d = if_else(
      str_detect(us_rep_14d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_sen_32d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_sen_32d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_rep_64d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_rep_64d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_rep_99d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_rep_99d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_20_1 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_20_1, "Sharon"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_20_2 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_20_2, "Judi"), "GOP", "DEM"),
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter voted exclusively for one party in the races of interest, besides the Supreme Court races
  mutate(
    party_line_voter = case_when(
      pres == "GOP" & us_rep_14d == "GOP" & state_sen_32d == "GOP" &
      (state_rep_64d == "GOP" | state_rep_99d == "GOP")
      ~ "GOP",
      pres == "DEM" & us_rep_14d == "DEM" & state_sen_32d == "DEM" &
      (state_rep_64d == "DEM" | state_rep_99d == "DEM")
      ~ "DEM",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter's Supreme Court race choices aligned with their choices for the other races of interest
  mutate(
    sc_races_matching = case_when(
      party_line_voter == "GOP" & sc_justice_20_1 == "GOP" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "GOP" ~ TRUE,
      party_line_voter == "DEM" & sc_justice_20_1 == "DEM" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "DEM" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: champaign-oh-2020

# Importing data
champaign_oh_2020_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/Ohio 2020/Data/Champaign County CVR Data/Champaign2020_G_Official.cvr/Champaign2020_G_Official.cvr.csv"
  ) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  suppressWarnings()

# Restructuring the data
champaign_oh_2020 <- champaign_oh_2020_raw |> 
  select(
    row_number, choice_1_2_president_vote_for_1_biden_harris_democratic,
    choice_2_3_president_vote_for_1_trump_pence_republican, 
    choice_18_2_us_congress_d4_vote_for_1_shannon_m_freshour_democratic,
    choice_19_3_us_congress_d4_vote_for_1_jim_jordan_republican,
    choice_21_3_state_senator_d12_vote_for_1_matt_huffman_republican,
    choice_22_2_state_senator_d12_vote_for_1_ken_poling_democratic,
    choice_3_1_supreme_court_1_1_2021_vote_for_1_sharon_l_kennedy_nonpartisan,
    choice_4_1_supreme_court_1_1_2021_vote_for_1_john_p_o_donnell_nonpartisan,
    choice_5_1_supreme_court_1_2_2021_vote_for_1_jennifer_brunner_nonpartisan,
    choice_6_1_supreme_court_1_2_2021_vote_for_1_judi_french_nonpartisan
    ) |> 
  
  # Creating ballot choices and binaries
  mutate(
    pres = case_when(
      choice_1_2_president_vote_for_1_biden_harris_democratic == 1 ~ "DEM",
      choice_2_3_president_vote_for_1_trump_pence_republican == 1 ~ "GOP",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    us_rep_4d = case_when(
      choice_18_2_us_congress_d4_vote_for_1_shannon_m_freshour_democratic == 1
      ~ "DEM",
      choice_19_3_us_congress_d4_vote_for_1_jim_jordan_republican == 1 ~ "GOP",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    state_sen_12d = case_when(
      choice_22_2_state_senator_d12_vote_for_1_ken_poling_democratic == 1
      ~ "DEM",
      choice_21_3_state_senator_d12_vote_for_1_matt_huffman_republican == 1
      ~ "GOP",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    sc_justice_20_1 = case_when(
      choice_4_1_supreme_court_1_1_2021_vote_for_1_john_p_o_donnell_nonpartisan
      == 1 ~ "DEM",
      choice_3_1_supreme_court_1_1_2021_vote_for_1_sharon_l_kennedy_nonpartisan
      == 1 ~ "GOP",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    sc_justice_20_2 = case_when(
      choice_5_1_supreme_court_1_2_2021_vote_for_1_jennifer_brunner_nonpartisan
      == 1 ~ "DEM",
      choice_6_1_supreme_court_1_2_2021_vote_for_1_judi_french_nonpartisan == 1
      ~ "GOP",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |> 

# Creating variable to label whether or not a voter voted exclusively for one party in the races of interest, besides the Supreme Court races
  mutate(
    party_line_voter = case_when(
      pres == "GOP" & us_rep_4d == "GOP" & state_sen_12d == "GOP" ~ "GOP",
      pres == "DEM" & us_rep_4d == "DEM" & state_sen_12d == "DEM" ~ "DEM",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter's Supreme Court race choices aligned with their choices for the other races of interest
  mutate(
    sc_races_matching = case_when(
      party_line_voter == "GOP" & sc_justice_20_1 == "GOP" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "GOP" ~ TRUE,
      party_line_voter == "DEM" & sc_justice_20_1 == "DEM" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "DEM" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) |> 
  
  # Final data frame cleaning; choosing not to drop the NAs
  select(
    row_number, pres, us_rep_4d, state_sen_12d, sc_justice_20_1,
    sc_justice_20_2, party_line_voter, sc_races_matching
  ) |> 
  rename(cast_vote_record = row_number)
```
